Review source-derived retrieval questions. Return JSON {"reviews":[{"id":same id,"supported":true/false,"reason":"brief"}]} in input order.
For each item verify that the supplied evidence excerpt contains the concrete information asked in both the
English and Chinese question. A general topic relationship is insufficient. Both questions must ask the same
detail. Mark unsupported if a question asks more than the quoted evidence supplies. Use only supplied text.

What is the main treatment doctors recommend for this type of seasonal depression?", "zh": "我从晚秋开始每个冬天都感到情绪低落和疲惫。医生推荐这种季节性抑郁的主要治疗方法是什么？"}, {"id": "single-056", "evidence": "But with a mechanical valve, you usually have to take blood thinners for the rest of your life to prevent blood clots.", "en": "My doctor mentioned I might need a heart valve replacement. Are there any vaccines available that can prevent parasitic diseases like malaria?", "zh": "我计划去一个疟疾流行的国家旅行。有没有可以预防像疟疾这样的寄生虫病的疫苗？"}, {"id": "single-058", "evidence": "Almost all cervical cancers are caused by a long-lasting infection with a virus called human papillomavirus (HPV) .", "en": "I heard that most cervical cancers are caused by a virus.
